subject: general
question: Who among the following musicians plays the tabla?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Zakir Husain__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ustaad Zakir Hussain** is an Indian Tabla player, music producer, composer, and film actor.
 
• Ustaad Zakir Khan was born on **9th March 1951**.
 
• He is the eldest son of tabla player **Ustaad Allah Rakha**.
 
• He is the recipient of Padma Shri</st
